measurement_contract.allocated_tree_semantics: AtM-managed allocation observation using existing C0 st_blocks x 512 Linux semantics
measurement_contract.available_bytes_semantics: statvfs f_bavail x f_frsize environment-specific observation

interpretation_rules: The observed available-byte deltas equal the measured allocated-tree bytes in these controlled tmpfs and ext4 qualification fixtures; this equality is evidence for these environments, not a filesystem-independent accounting identity.
allocated_tree_bytes is the AtM-managed allocation observation for the exact canonical trash tree and reuses the existing C0 measurement implementation.
available_bytes_delta is an environment-specific statvfs observation and must not become a runtime purge threshold, reclaim guarantee, or loop-until-empty condition.
A successful observation requires exact trash removal and preservation of the normal snapshot namespace.
No startup, background, Optimizations-toggle, repository-refresh, conversation-delete, ENOSPC or capacity-failure purge trigger is selected by this evidence.
No universal reclaim ratio, fixed reserve, or production free-space threshold is selected by C1-M1.
